_doc: VERIFY-INTEGRITY-3 baseline for scripts/check-default-build-quiet.py. This is DEBT, NOT an approved list. Every tag here is diagnostic output that a DEFAULT build prints to a real user with no MC2_* env set -- measured from a tier1 smoke run, not inferred from grep. Nine of them recur every 600 frames forever during play (STATIC_UPDATE, APPEAR_ROUTE, ANIM_GATE, CAMERA_MOTION, TEX_RESOLVE, RENDER_STATES, TERRAIN_LIGHTING_GPU, WATER_FULL_RECIPE_AUTH, WATER_REFL_RT). Three (CLUSTER_DEPTH_PYRAMID, LIGHTGRID_BUILD, POSTPROCESS_BLUR) sit inside their own IsEnabled() resolver and so announce features that are OFF. The ratchet only ever tightens: gating a tag and removing it here is always correct; adding a tag requires a keep reason.
